responsibility: Defines ARM inline-assembly register classes and registers, including VFP/NEON register typing, q-register modifier emission, overlap relationships between s/d/q views, and target-mode validation for frame-pointer, Thumb-1, and RWPI-reserved registers.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `abi/call/arm.rs`, this ARM file defines the inline `asm!` register surface—general and VFP/NEON register classes, q-register modifiers, overlapping s/d/q views, and Thumb/frame-pointer/RWPI restrictions—instead of call ABI lowering.
